_comment: Railway config for the FRONTEND service. Point the service at this file in
The build context is the REPOSITORY ROOT, same as the backend, because the Dockerfile does
VITE_API_URL is baked in at BUILD time, because Vite inlines it into the bundle. Changing the
API hostname therefore needs a REBUILD, not a restart. Set it as a service variable before the
first deploy, and redeploy after any change to it.
healthcheckPath is / because this is a static bundle: there is nothing to be 'not ready' for
once the process is serving. The backend is the one with a meaningful readiness distinction.
